from motherduck.food_table_compounds_flat_prediction_average
where user_hash_id = '${params.user_hash_id}'
  and ('${inputs.model_filter}' IN ('', 'undefined', 'null') OR model_name = '${inputs.model_filter.value}')
  and compound is not null and compound != '')
ON average_state_point, average_sleep_point, average_bloating_point, average_reflux_point, average_finger_point

    NAME state_name

select 'What can be in common in these compounds that make me sleepy? ' ||
